name: mesh-vpn
description: Decentralized mesh VPN with WebRTC, onion encryption, and multipath routing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,exit "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run exit"
scripts.sig:exit: concurrently -n server,exit "npm run server" "npm run exit"
scripts.sig:client: concurrently -n server,client "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build:boring-tls-helper: cmake -S native/boring_tls -B native/boring_tls/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native/boring_tls/build --target boring-tls-helper --parallel $(node -p "Math.max(1, require('os').cpus().length - 1)")
scripts.build:boring-tls-helper-lowmem: cmake -S native/boring_tls -B native/boring_tls/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native/boring_tls/build --target boring-tls-helper --parallel 1
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:tun-linux || true; cd helpers && make 2>/dev/null || true
